From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>

Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: ClearStream onramp runway — data lifecycle & security milestone checklist

Alex / Security team —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. As promised, I attached an initial mutual action plan (MAP_ClearStream_v1.xlsx) that sketches milestones and the gating checklist for the POC close. High-level security/compliance gates we expect to hit as part of the MAP: 

- SOC 2: provide our latest SOC 2 Type II report (we can share within the next 5 business days once legal confirms redactions).
- SIG/CAIQ: we included a compact SIG worksheet (SIG_Assessment_stub.xlsx) with the items your team flagged during the call.
- DPA: DPA redline attached (DPA_redline_20270520.pdf). We can accept most of the EU data residency carveouts but would like to propose a single contract clause for subprocessor notice rather than per-change approvals.
- Data retention: default retention tiers we support: 30 days (hot), 365 days (cold) for transactional logs. For EU-residency customers we can commit to region-based storage for PII and offer a 90-day retention option for the POC.

Next steps I propose:
1) Your security team to review attached SIG stub and mark any must-block items by EOD Mon 5/24.
2) We share SOC 2 artifact and final DPA redline by Wed 5/26.
3) Target mutual sign-off on MAP milestones by Fri 5/28 to keep the POC launch in the first week of June.

Can you confirm the internal owner on your side for the gating checklist and a go/no-go decision date?

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
---

From: Alex Torres <alex@clearstream.com>

Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 11:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: ClearStream onramp runway — data lifecycle & security milestone checklist

Ben —

Thanks for the MAP and the attachments. A few clarifying questions from our InfoSec and legal teams:

1) SOC 2: will you be able to provide the full Type II report or only an executive summary + SOC auditor letter? We typically require the full report under an NDA.
2) DPA redline: our counsel prefers explicit language on EU data residency and deletion timelines. For the POC we need confirmation that datasets marked as EU-only will not leave EU storage and that deletion requests are honored within 7 business days after termination. Is 7 business days feasible?
3) SIG: we filled out an initial questionnaire (attached) with technical follow-ups on key management and access logs — can you route this to your engineering security owner?

Also looping security@clearstream.com (ops) — Tomas is the SecOps lead and will coordinate the SIG Qs. Our proposed internal approval timeline is to complete gating review by Tue 5/25 so we can keep your target MAP dates.

Appreciate it —
Alex Torres
Senior Product Manager, Integrations
ClearStream Payments

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Torres <alex@clearstream.com>, security@clearstream.com
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ClearStream onramp runway — data lifecycle & security milestone checklist

Ben / team —

Thanks Alex — I reviewed the SIG spreadsheet and the questions in ClearStream_SIG_Questions_20270521.xlsx. Draft responses and recommended contract positions below (highlights):

- SOC 2: We can provide the SOC 2 Type II report under NDA. Legal recommends a standard mutual NDA for artifact exchange; once executed we will deliver the redacted PDF within 3 business days.
- DPA / EU residency: We are prepared to commit to EU data residency for PII and model-inference artifacts for ClearStream accounts. For the POC we can guarantee region-bound storage in eu-west-1. Regarding deletion timelines, our standard is 30 days for application-level data and 7 business days for administrative deletion requests on customer-managed data — we can agree to 7 business days in the DPA for PII deletion for the POC only. We will mark that carveout in the attached DPA_redline_20270520.pdf.
- SIG technicals: Our engineering security lead (cc’ing Laura) will answer KMS and access-log questions. Short answers:
  * KMS: We support customer-managed keys (KMS) on Dedicated/Private deployments and offer envelope encryption for hosted accounts; for POC we can enable customer KMS with a limited scoped key.
  * Audit logs: Full request logs (token-level metadata) retained for 90 days by default; we can extend retention on request.

Proposed timeline given ClearStream's approval cadence:
- Mon 5/24: ClearStream marks must-block SIG items and returns any additional questions.
- Wed 5/26: We provide SOC 2 under NDA + finalized DPA redline.
- Fri 5/28: Mutual sign-off on MAP to keep June POC start.

Please let me know if legal needs a different DPA clause on subprocessor notification.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Sr. Counsel, Privacy & Security | Redwood Inference
